hooks.text: Salon ki raat 11 baje, phone par message, aur koi jawab nahi…
Salon ka reel kitne second mein chhod dete hain log?
Main reel scripts ke baare mein galat tha…
Asli sachchai ye hai ki pehli line…
Reels ka pehla second waste karna band karo…
Salon ka reel chala, lekin raat ko message kare toh koi uthata nahi…

beats.line: Salon ke owners, raat ko der raat bhi aapke messages ignore ho rahe hain?
beats.visual: Phone screen glowing in dark, unread messages piling up

beats.line: Naya reel roz banana solution nahi hai, kyunki customer ko apna sawal sunna chahiye, sirf offer nahi. Toh kya kaam karega?
beats.visual: Owner filming a reel while a customer scrolls past without stopping

beats.line: Aur asli dikkat script ki pehli line mein hai, jo main batata hoon…
beats.visual: Close-up of handwritten script lines on a phone

beats.line: Sabse pehle aap customers ka sawal likhte hain, kyunki reel uska jawab degi. Phir pehli line mein wahi sawal uthate hain, taaki log ruk jayein, aur aakhir mein unhe message bhejne ko kehte hain.
beats.visual: Notepad me sawal, reel frame me wahi sawal, message bubble ke saath CTA
steps: sawal ko pehli line mein uthao

beats.line: Cameratel ke mutabik, haptah mein 2-3 videos bana sakte hain, jo kaafi hota hai, isliye script kaam karegi.
beats.visual: Calendar with three video icons per week and a checkmark
steps: Cameratel ke mutabik, haptah mein 2-3 videos
bana sakte hain, jo kaafi hota hai

beats.line: Salon ka reel chala ho, lekin agar pehli line customer ka sawal nahi uthati, toh message koi nahi utha payega.
beats.visual: Salon owner looking at phone, then at script paper

beats.line: Agar aapke salon ke liye reel script chahiye, toh comment mein SCRIPT likho. Main aapko DM mein one-page checklist aur fill-in template bhejunga. Poora breakdown aaj ke carousel mein hai.
beats.visual: Text 'Comment SCRIPT' with arrow to comment box

master_script.cta: Agar aapke salon ke liye reel script chahiye, toh comment mein SCRIPT likho. Main aapko DM mein one-page checklist aur fill-in template bhejunga. Poora breakdown aaj ke carousel mein hai.
master_script.linkedin_english: If you run a salon, your reel might get views but no night-time messages because the first line does not ask the customer's real question. Instead of posting every day, write one script that answers the most common query and ends with a clear invitation to message. Comment SCRIPT and I will send you a one-page checklist with the lines every business reel script needs, plus a fill-in template.
